instruction: A candid documentary wide shot captures an indoor motion capture studio with a red carpeted floor and white walls. The man in the black polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) stands on the left, facing right in profile. The woman in the white patterned t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) stands on the right, facing left towards him. She places her left hand on the man's chest in a guiding gesture. The scene is illuminated by bright overhead fluorescent lighting, casting soft shadows on the red carpet.
